Your holdings: Several positions need immediate attention, especially given you're on margin. SOXL (-57.51%) and SPAL (-57.02%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and broken stops. SMH (-17.05%) and QQQI (-8.02%) also have broken stops, while QQQ (-5.8%) is very close to its stop. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on upcoming tech earnings this week and any further news regarding China's impact on the semiconductor industry.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management and stop-loss adherence, especially on leveraged positions.
plays: Respect QQQ stop at 670; consider trimming if it breaks.

Address SMH (current 527.88, stop 540), SOXL (current 108.14, stop 200), SPAL (current 10.81, stop 21.38), and QQQI (current 51.88, stop 52) as their stops are already broken; re-evaluate these leveraged and high-loss positions to manage risk.
